verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents its own grant-issuance workflow: creating, signing and sharing award contracts one by one or in bulk, with automated granting, document and signature workflows. Nothing in the evidence shows a board-approval step or 409A valuation and strike-price handling, so only the granting core of the end-to-end story is supported. Missing for 10: board approval flow, 409A-compliant strike price setting, evidence of a single end-to-end new-hire option workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
